data_policy.theme_context: july_2026_theme_timeline.csv; a row becomes usable only from valid_from
data_policy.same_day_new_theme: not tradable unless separately timestamped intraday source existed before decision; v1 defaults to next-day only

core_confirmation.same_theme_confirmation: at least 2 named representatives excluding the candidate must show non-negative return at the decision window OR one representative is limit-up/near-limit while capacity core is positive
core_confirmation.market_confirmation: whole-market median return at decision window must not be below -1.5%, except ice_point_repair

prerequisites: prior theme is confirmed/accelerating/repair and not retreat
leader_divergence_to_consensus.trigger: candidate opens between -4% and +5%; after a completed observation minute recovers above previous close or above day open; is in upper 60% of its intraday range; same-theme confirmation passes
forbidden: prior-day theme leader failed with batch limit-down contagion
candidate already >8.5% above prior close at observation
whole-market severe deterioration without repair evidence

prerequisites: prior expectation is normal divergence/repair rather than certain acceleration
leader_weak_to_strong.trigger: open gap between -3.5% and +2%; completed observation shows return >= +1%, price above day open, intraday range position >=70%, same-theme confirmation passes
forbidden: market breadth keeps worsening from 09:35 to observation

prerequisites: new theme was documented no later than prior close in v1
new theme has at least two named representatives
low_level_switch.trigger: new-theme leader positive and above day open; at least two representatives positive; old-theme negative anchors remain weak; candidate not already >8.5% at observation
forbidden: new theme was identified only by post-close hindsight on same date
old theme unexpectedly reclaims leadership before entry

prerequisites: same-theme leader is already confirmed strong that day
theme was a prior mainline candidate
supplement_after_leader_confirmed.trigger: leader remains strong; supplement turns positive with range position >=70%; board breadth not contracting
forbidden: supplement is mid-level crowded stock without clear role

prerequisites: candidate is a named low-level core or capacity core
ice_point_repair.trigger: whole-market breadth improves by >=10 percentage points from 09:35; candidate return >=1%; at least two same-theme representatives positive; no old negative anchor reversal is required
forbidden: candidate is simply prior high-level loser rebounding without theme breadth

cash.trigger: no other playbook passes all prerequisites and triggers

execution.month_end: liquidate at 2026-07-31 close for measurement only and mark evaluation liquidation

exit.hard_failure: first sellable day after entry: if 10:00 completed return from entry <= -5%, exit next minute open
exit.expectation_failure: first sellable day: if candidate <= -2.5% vs prior close and below day open while theme confirmation fails, exit next minute open
exit.leader_loss_of_status: if prior-day review demotes the stock to negative_anchor/retreat and position is sellable, exit at next day first valid evaluation window
exit.right_tail: do not use fixed small take-profit; after MFE >=10%, protect only after >=5% drawdown from post-entry peak or loss of core status
exit.time_stop: after 3 sellable days, if return from entry <3% and stock never established/retained core status, exit
exit.max_holding: 7 sellable days unless still explicitly a core in latest available review

learning.temporary_risk_response: 2 consecutive process-valid losses in same playbook -> next two eligible signals half size; 3 consecutive -> pause new entries for two trading days
